description: Human form of the unknown --model refusal: Detail lists the nearest models, Action is the corrected command.

files.content:
---
name: demo
kind: program
---
Say hi.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: That command isn't quite right.
Detail: --model "model-lnua" is not a model this account may run; nearest: model-luna, model-astra, model-sol; `prose cli model list` lists them all
Action: Rerun with a model the service offers, for example `prose cli run submit p.prose.md --model model-luna`.
